Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Tumninos :

Requires a ready non-Sterile Ravnos with a capacity above 4. +1 stealth
action. Put this card in play. It becomes a 2-capacity Ravnos with one
level of Chimerstry. You may move a master: Discipline card from your
hand to this vampire (pay cost as normal). This vampire is not
considered unique, must hunt this turn, and is the same sect as the
acting Ravnos.

My question is about the "From your hand" part. Do you need to have the
Discipline card in your hand

a) when you play the Tumninos (put it on the table with it)
b) right after you've replaced the Tumninos
c) when the action to put Tumninos on play succeeds (so you can replace
after the last stealth card if any)

I'd say C but need to B sure...

T.I.A.

Orpheus

Messages.Author: Olive...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:


Definitely c), since it lacks any card text saying otherwise (like:
when you announce this action etc). Any effects on an Action cards are
resolved when the action succeeds (again, barring card text). This is
not like Disguised Weapon, which is resolved immediately b/c it's a
combat card.

> T.I.A.
>
> Orpheus
